title: Heavy rains to drench Metro Manila, Luzon areas on Saturday afternoon

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Heavy downpour may occur in Metro Manila and several areas in Luzon on Saturday afternoon, Sept. 19, brought by localized thunderstorms and the effects of the southwest monsoon, or habagat, the state weather bureau said.
